strings.name: Ray Dalio
strings.summary: Ray Dalio is an American investor who founded Bridgewater in 1975, combining macroeconomic analysis with systematic investing and helping develop risk parity allocation. His Principles and books on debt cycles explain his investing and management ideas. Bridgewater’s culture of transparency has also drawn controversy. In 2025 he sold his remaining stake and left its board, completing a long transition.
